plan.rationale:
SOURCE SELECTION (observation): From study_packet.history.rows I select the verified completed evaluation batch-43a6daab7e3c1ce6-3 (configuration artifact e30da8ea…, execution 50618bf23b31464ba4f84c55cd26d1ca, owner batch-43a6daab7e3c1ce6-3) as the structure/control source. It is chosen separately from the retained baseline (baseline-replay, execution cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef) and from the latest tested candidate (batch-9293a74b063bb9a0-0, execution a8382f8a4c6e4ebe921fb72f821b2188), as required. Justification: on the shared structure identity ab220124976af3c068e7002eaadaf8216b383d7fbc6f6437d70b61db1b680060 it is the verified evaluated point closest to joint acceptance in a distinct recipe — it passed terminal_reach (terminal_error_m 0.008187) and holding position (holding_max_error_m 0.008275) and failed only holding speed (holding_max_speed_m_s 0.035567 vs the 0.02 m/s criterion) — so a one-parameter structural perturbation is well placed to reveal whether holding-phase margins are structure-sensitive. The completed joint-positive Step 2 result (a8382f8a…) is retained as campaign context only; it fixes the best-known acceptance point but is not used as source, since the source must be selected separately from the latest tested and it shares the identical structure identity.

FROZEN CONTROLLER RECIPE (observation/fixed condition): the source recipe is held fixed at control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 and control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.05 — both speed weights fixed. This is a structural sensitivity study, not controller optimization; the recipe therefore lives under controller_implementation/other_numerical_settings and is not varied.

PROPOSED TEST (hypothesis): vary exactly one canonical length path, components/near/length_m, from 0.15 m to 0.16 m (typed continuous bounds [0.15, 0.16], which include source and point), preserving every undeclared structural field, material, actuation, initializer, timing, solver and horizon. Prediction: the holding-phase maxima move measurably relative to the source execution while terminal reach and force bounds stay satisfied.
